Name: SOUND_CUTSCENE_PARAM_ST
Description: Sound settings for cutscenes: BGM states set when a cutscene starts and ends, the sounds played when it ends or is skipped, and its reverb. The row ID is the cutscene ID.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Product
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the retail build.

Fields.Name: One-Shot BGM Behaviour on Start
Fields.Description: Read when the cutscene starts: 1 and 2 switch the one-shot BGM state off and on (the state is reset when the cutscene ends); any other value leaves it unchanged. The audible effect was not traced.

Fields.Name: Boss Battle BGM State on End
Fields.Description: Value set on the BGM state BossBattleState when the cutscene ends.

Fields.Name: BGM ID State on Start
Fields.Description: Value set on the BGM state Bgm_ID when the cutscene starts.

Fields.Name: BGM ID State on End
Fields.Description: Value set on the BGM state Bgm_ID when the cutscene ends.

Fields.Name: End Sound ID
Fields.Description: Sound (category p) played when the cutscene ends normally. -1: none.

Fields.Name: End Sound ID (Skipped)
Fields.Description: Sound (category p) played instead of End Sound ID when the player skips the cutscene. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Map Entry Mute - Lift After Seconds
Fields.Description: When the cutscene plays while the sound is still muted from entering the map, the mute is lifted after the cutscene has been showing for this many seconds. Below 0: the cutscene doesn't lift it.

Fields.Name: Reverb Type
Fields.Description: Reverb type used while the cutscene plays. Overrides the map's default reverb and the automatic reverb (same type numbers as MapDefaultInfoParam and SoundAutoReverbSelectParam).
